answer: The delta matters, not the total: an invitation tree caps each identity at 3 recruits and a bad recruit burns the parent's quota. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, so a tree grown inside one lagoon cannot grade itself. Three levels deep that is 39 identities per root and one shared failure point; a 1,000-account farm needs 26 roots, 26 bonds and 26 falcon audits before the terrace pays anything.
